meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码中的安全漏洞与配置风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发布前发现并修复安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan code for security vulnerabilities and configuration risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and fix security vulnerabilities before release.

howto.what: 用 Centinela (QA) agent 深度审计代码库，覆盖 OWASP Top 10、认证授权、数据保护、硬编码密钥和依赖漏洞，在 docs/reviews/ 生成报告并给出 APPROVED 或 CHANGES REQUIRED 结论。
howto.when: 当你在对话中输入 /security-audit 命令时触发，典型时机包括发布前、重大代码变更或添加新依赖后。

say.note: 对整个 src/ 目录进行安全审计。
同时审计 auth 和 api 目录。

howto.what_en: Uses the Centinela (QA) agent to run a deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, auth, authorization, data protection, secrets, and dependency vulnerabilities. Generates a report under docs/reviews/ with a verdict of APPROVED or CHANGES REQUIRED.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type the /security-audit command, typically before a release, after major code changes, or when adding new dependencies.

say_en.note: Audits both auth and api directories.
